relationships.evidence_quote: After further administration of candesartan, the expression levels of IBA-1 were markedly decreased (Fig. 3A).

key_findings: Candesartan reduced morphine-induced AT1R, inflammatory cytokines (TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6) and IBA-1 in BV2 microglia in a dose-dependent manner.
The effects were reversed by the PPARγ antagonist GW9662 and AMPK inhibitor compound C, implicating PPARγ/AMPK signaling.
